pages.text: The $(item)Metal Crystallizer$() uses energy to entice metal ore to grow into raw crystal spires.
How much do you need? - Yes
An valid ore block needs to be placed beneath the Crystallizer and an inventory on top. If the top inventory is missing an $(thing)Ore Crystal Spire$() will grow in its place
The output amount is only limited by the space in the inventory and the energy supplied. To get more energy into the Crystallizer and $(item)Energy Input Hatch$() can be used.
